metadata.description: Synthetic Simu5G failure scenarios for TelecomRAG RCA demos

scenarios.name: PCI Collision
scenarios.description: Two neighboring cells assigned same PCI causing interference
scenarios.root_cause: Incorrect PCI planning in dense urban deployment
scenarios.resolution: Re-assign PCI for Cell_002 to avoid collision
scenarios.context: Simu5G Scenario SIM-001: PCI Collision. Two neighboring cells assigned same PCI causing interference. Root Cause: Incorrect PCI planning in dense urban deployment. Resolution: Re-assign PCI for Cell_002 to avoid collision. Symptoms: High interference, Frequent HO failures, Reduced SINR.

scenarios.name: RACH Overload
scenarios.description: Excessive Random Access attempts causing preamble collision
scenarios.root_cause: Massive IoT device registration after power outage recovery
scenarios.resolution: Adjust PRACH configuration (increase preambles, backoff timer)
scenarios.context: Simu5G Scenario SIM-002: RACH Overload. Excessive Random Access attempts causing preamble collision. Root Cause: Massive IoT device registration after power outage recovery. Resolution: Adjust PRACH configuration (increase preambles, backoff timer). Symptoms: RRC setup failures, High PRACH utilization, Access delays.

scenarios.name: Beam Failure Recovery
scenarios.description: UE unable to maintain beam alignment in mmWave frequency
scenarios.root_cause: Moving obstacles in dense urban canyon affecting mmWave beams
scenarios.context: Simu5G Scenario SIM-003: Beam Failure Recovery. UE unable to maintain beam alignment in mmWave frequency. Root Cause: Moving obstacles in dense urban canyon affecting mmWave beams. Resolution: Optimize beam management parameters. Symptoms: RLF events, Throughput drops, Beam failure indications.

scenarios.name: Handover Ping-Pong
scenarios.description: Rapid successive handovers between two cells
scenarios.root_cause: A3 event hysteresis configured too low (1dB)
scenarios.resolution: Increase A3 hysteresis to 3dB, adjust TTT to 320ms
scenarios.context: Simu5G Scenario SIM-004: Handover Ping-Pong. Rapid successive handovers between two cells. Root Cause: A3 event hysteresis configured too low (1dB). Resolution: Increase A3 hysteresis to 3dB, adjust TTT to 320ms. Symptoms: High HO rate, Signaling storm, Poor user experience.

scenarios.name: Backhaul Congestion
scenarios.description: Backhaul link saturated causing E2E throughput degradation
scenarios.root_cause: Unexpected traffic surge from stadium event
scenarios.resolution: Implement QoS prioritization and traffic shaping
scenarios.context: Simu5G Scenario SIM-005: Backhaul Congestion. Backhaul link saturated causing E2E throughput degradation. Root Cause: Unexpected traffic surge from stadium event. Resolution: Implement QoS prioritization and traffic shaping. Symptoms: Low throughput, High latency, Packet drops.
